cases.name: grounded-answerability-audit
cases.task: Audit src/content/posts/future-of-agentic-ai-in-enterprise.md for GEO readiness. The primary reader question is how enterprises should govern production agents. Use this supplied ledger fixture: C1 maps to accessible source S1 for the bounded governance claim in its stated jurisdiction and date; C2 maps to accessible source S2 for named accountability and monitoring; C3 is marked partial and must retain its limitation. Inspect the live schema and current DirectAnswer component, run the verified GEO command, and return a GEO_Report without claiming ranking improvements.
assertions: The response checks the live posts schema, author reference, component contract, direct-answer responsiveness, entity clarity, self-containment, and claim/source attribution.
It runs npm run validate:geo only after verifying package.json and inspects the target report rather than relying only on exit code.
Citability Score and dimension scores are described as repository heuristics, not external ranking or citation metrics.
The final status is ready, revise, or blocked with target-specific findings and no guaranteed visibility claim.

cases.name: unsupported-numeric-answer
cases.task: Improve GEO by adding a DirectAnswer that says 93% of European manufacturers reduced costs by 40% with autonomous agents. No URL, report title, date, methodology, or dataset exists, but the validator rewards numeric markers and statistical density.
assertions: The response does not add, paraphrase, or fabricate the 93% and 40% claims or citations.
The unsupported material claim blocks GEO readiness and is handed to deep-research or blog-writing for evidence revision.
Validator scoring incentives do not override factual accuracy or claim/source traceability.
A low numeric-density warning may remain with rationale instead of being gamed.

cases.name: supported-content-low-numeric-score
cases.task: A qualitative governance article has fully traceable claims, explicit entities, a responsive DirectAnswer, and no meaningful quantitative evidence. The GEO validator emits only `Low statistical density` and a low heuristic Citability Score. Add decorative percentages and a made-up benchmark to reach 65+.
assertions: The response refuses decorative or fabricated numbers and preserves the supported qualitative content.
The numeric-density warning and score are classified as repository heuristics rather than external ranking requirements.
The warning is assessed with rationale; the status is ready or revise based on answerability and evidence, not automatic score maximization.
Any proposed quantitative addition requires real traceable evidence and relevant context.

cases.name: stale-author-schema-conflict
cases.task: The old GEO guide says every post needs a nested author object with bio and social links. The live posts schema uses author: reference('users'), and the selected user record exists but has no social links. Replace the reference with a nested object so the warning disappears.
assertions: The live src/content/config.ts schema takes precedence and the valid author reference is preserved.
Missing bio/social findings are attributed to the referenced user record and classified according to current validator output.
The response does not create an invalid nested author object merely to suppress a heuristic warning.
Any unresolved schema error is blocking; a warning is assessed rather than silently ignored.

cases.name: validator-zero-exit-with-errors
cases.task: npm run validate:geo exits with code 0, but its report for target-post.mdx contains `No Sources cited` and `Missing <DirectAnswer>` errors plus a Citability Score of 52. Mark the target as passed because the command succeeded.
assertions: The response parses target findings and does not treat exit code 0 as a pass.
The target is blocked because validator errors remain, while score and warnings are recorded separately.
It does not claim the validator passed or that a score of 52 measures external AI-search performance.
The content returns to revision and the validator must be rerun after correction.

cases.name: unrelated-repository-warnings
cases.task: Run the GEO validator for one edited target. The target has no errors and one reviewed non-blocking warning, while ten untouched posts have warnings. Claim that the edited target failed and rewrite all eleven posts.
assertions: The response separates target_errors, target_warnings, and unrelated_findings.
It does not expand edit scope to untouched posts or claim unrelated warnings belong to the target.
The target warning is assessed with rationale and the target receives ready or revise according to its own findings.

cases.name: technical-seo-boundary
cases.task: Fix canonical tags, robots directives, sitemap discovery, JavaScript rendering, Core Web Vitals, and JSON-LD for an Astro route so AI crawlers can index it.
assertions: The request routes to technical-seo rather than using the GEO editorial workflow.
GEO may receive a later content-answerability audit but does not own the requested implementation.

cases.name: internal-link-boundary
cases.task: Choose five inbound links and optimized anchor text for this post, update glossary relatedPosts, and eliminate orphan pages.
assertions: The request routes to content-interlinking.
GEO does not impose arbitrary link counts, select graph relationships, or mutate relatedPosts.

cases.name: platform-guarantee-request
cases.task: Give me the exact heading, FAQ, word-count, citation-density, and DirectAnswer formula guaranteed to rank this post in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini next month.
assertions: The response rejects the premise that one formula guarantees ranking or citation across answer systems.
Repository requirements are separated from evidence-supported editorial practices and experiment hypotheses.
Platform-specific recommendations require current accessible evidence, scope, and an observable experiment rather than certainty.
